lines.q: Which country is bigger, Brazil or Australia?
lines.a: Brazil! By almost eight hundred thousand square kilometres.
Japan! About a quarter bigger than Italy.
Kazakhstan! Almost three times bigger. It's the ninth largest country on Earth.
Turkey! Even with all of France's overseas regions counted. Think you can get all four? Go again!
